newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber prices end down.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber prices end down.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices fell further at the close after the market ended another day on virtually no trading, dealers said.
The Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted May RSS1 buyer at 279.50 cents ($1.12) a kg, down three cents from Wednesday. May SMR20 buyer was one cent lower to 265.50.
A check with trading houses showed the SMR 20 being offered at 259 cents a kg, SMR CV at 335, SMR L at 313, SMR 5 at 272, SMR 10 at 260 and drum latex FOB at 228.
Traders said the market was void of leads.
"Sellers are just offering further and further discounts in the hope for the best," said a trader.

The INRO five-day moving indicator was quoted at 213.89 Malaysian/Singaporean cents per kg on April 23, compared to 215.50 on April 22. The daily indicator was also lower at 210.37 from 212.06 previously.
